'''5 ABY''' was the fifth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

This year was known as '''Year 40''' after the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*[[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] tried to defect to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] but was assassinated by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] on [[Ciutric IV]].<ref name="MR" />
*[[Ysanne Isard]] took control of the Empire.<ref name="MR" />
*The [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] [[Kessendra Coronation|met]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="TGoDV" /> in an attempt to subvert Ysanne Isard's rulership of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] and [[Trioculus]] were defeated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TGoDV" />
*[[Fort Nowhere]] was completely [[Battle of Fort Nowhere|destroyed]].<ref name="DFJK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
*[[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] and his [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] were [[Mission to Ruusan|defeated]] by [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="SW:JK:DFII">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref>
*[[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] was liberated by the New Republic.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
*[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] was captured by Isard, but was transferred to Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was captured by Isard on a [[scouting mission to Coruscant]] and was imprisoned in the [[Lusankya (prison)|''Lusankya'' facility]].<ref name="TNEC" />
*[[Yevetha]] captured [[Black Fifteen]]; [[Duskhan League]] formed.
*Resurrection of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] by his [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|father]] and [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|nephew]].
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Most comfortable chair ever designed|levitating pillow-chair]] categorically recognised as the most comfortable ever designed in the [[Galaxy]].
*[[Tiercam Dam]] burst on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and flooded the [[Valley of Royalty]] with [[Acid/Legends|acid]].
*[[Eriadu Authority]] was fragmented after the defeat of [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]]. Delvardus fled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] was liberated by the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" />
*The Empire abandoned [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]], [[Deysum III]] and [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].<ref name="TEA" />
